## Core Question

How does social position influence what individuals learn, repeat, and retain in their vocal repertoires over time?

## Approach

This project combines controlled colony experiments, manual behavioural observations, automated video capture, and acoustic analysis to connect shifting social relationships with changes in warble song structure.

## Why It Matters

Budgerigars offer a powerful system for asking how vocal learning unfolds inside real social networks rather than in isolated pairs. The broader goal is to understand how communication systems change when social worlds change.

## Current Direction

The thesis focuses on fission-fusion experiments in lab colonies and links network-derived predictors to acoustic structure at note, motif, and sequence levels.
